title: TOMLKit 配置保真开发任务
description: 固定真实源码上的 2 项完整需求／BUG；调查、方案确认、实施与修复在各自原会话连续推进。

scenarios.title: 修复 Array 的 *=，保留文档绑定、合法格式和现有数组操作。

tasks.goal: 修复 Array 的 *=，保留文档绑定、合法格式和现有数组操作。
tasks.prompt:
We need to complete a real development change in this pinned project. First inspect the actual source and supplied business reproduction, explain the relevant call path and edge cases, and raise any clarification questions. Propose a concrete plan with compatibility and test coverage, and wait for my confirmation before editing. Continue the implementation and any validation fixes in this same conversation and workspace. The following describes the eventual delivery scope, not an instruction to skip investigation or plan agreement:

Fix in-place repetition for Array in the supplied reproducer. The same Array object must remain bound to the document, and its values, index operations, unwrap, and serialized TOML must agree after valid repetition counts. Follow Python list index-count semantics, preserve exact text for *= 1, and retain existing comments and the behavior of unrelated array operations. Changes to formatting may be local to material newly added or cleared by repetition. Include regression tests within the allowed paths.

The following describes the eventual delivery scope, not an instruction to skip investigation or plan agreement:
